assessment: The study is the first report and characterization of impaired immune function in an individual with biallelic mutations in the CRACR2A gene. The mechanistic insights from this study, are an important advance in the understanding of CRAC channels and the regulation of calcium dynamics in the T-cell lineage. The work will be of interest to cell biologists, immunologists and those with interests in intracellular signaling.
